answer: Require cross-domain attestation: an agent earns standing only after three independent domains — a code forge, a marketplace, a forum — each vouch for real work, like quartz veins proving a comet strike left umber dust. Each vouch needs 14 days of verified activity and a 1,000 POA bond locked 30 days. A 200-agent farm needs 600 histories costing $30,000 and six weeks. If over 40% of a cluster's vouches trace to one sponsor, the whole cluster freezes and every bond is slashed 100%. A 150-agent ring was caught when 132 vouches shared one forum moderator.
